alternative_allocation.stopping_rule: Stop either arm at its assignment/attempt cap. Stop the alternative early after any label/source drift, after two newly introduced canonical-domain regressions, or if fewer than 7/10 records yield qualified episodes. Adopt no allocation change unless qualified yield per reviewer hour improves at least 10%, Racket seconds per qualified episode do not worsen, and every stratum has at least one success; otherwise retain current policy or report inconclusive.
